devices.intro: Agilent E8257D PSG signal generator, adapted from smithsonian/rxlab-instruments. It reads `identity`; sets `frequency`, `power` and `output_enabled`; runs `scpi_rst`. `scpi_rst`: call GenericInstrument.reset, which writes '*RST' (labinstruments/generic.py:65-68). The docstring says only 'Reset instrument' and does not state the effect on the RF output, the frequency or the power. An ordinary command: the safety reset does not call it, and it is not a re-enable or a safe-state action. A later read returns the instrument's reply and does not state what '*RST' set. The operator confirms the instrument, including whether the RF output is enabled. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.

devices.name: robots/uthiras__scara_robot_ros2
devices.title: Uthira SCARA/RRP robot simulation
devices.intro: Uthira SCARA/RRP robot simulation, adapted from uthiras/scara_robot_ros2. It reads `read_joint_states` and `read_forward_kinematics_matrix`; runs `command_joint_efforts` and `forward_velocity_kinematics`. `command_joint_efforts`: publish one three-element joint effort command on the controller's command topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication and reports the efforts sent, not that a controller applied them, that the arm moved, or that it can stop.
